title: Deploy an App with Helm
description: Install a Bitnami NGINX chart, upgrade it, and then clean up.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Experience the full lifecycle of a Helm release using the Bitnami NGINX chart.

### Steps
1. Add the Bitnami repository:
   ```bash
   helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
   helm repo update
   ```
2. Search for the nginx chart: `helm search repo bitnami/nginx`.
3. Install the chart with release name `my-nginx`:
   ```bash
   helm install my-nginx bitnami/nginx
   ```
4. Check the release: `helm list`, `helm status my-nginx`.
5. Get the default values: `helm show values bitnami/nginx`.
6. Upgrade the release to change the service type to NodePort and increase replicas to 2:
   ```bash
   helm upgrade my-nginx bitnami/nginx --set service.type=NodePort --set replicaCount=2
   ```
7. Verify the upgrade: `helm history my-nginx`, `kubectl get pods`.
8. Rollback to the first revision: `helm rollback my-nginx 1` (or just `helm rollback my-nginx`).
9. Confirm rollback: `helm history my-nginx`, check pods count.
10. Uninstall the release: `helm uninstall my-nginx`.
11. Verify no resources remain.
hints: Use `--wait` during install/upgrade to wait for all resources to be ready.
If the release name already exists, use `helm uninstall` first.
After uninstall, check with `kubectl get all`.
expectedOutput: Successful install, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall with no leftover resources.
solutionCode:
helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
helm install my-nginx bitnami/nginx
helm upgrade my-nginx bitnami/nginx --set service.type=NodePort --set replicaCount=2
helm rollback my-nginx
helm uninstall my-nginx
